utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. I’ll stick to the plan and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, just text me if you need anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly hands and a pickup if you’ve got one. I’ll send you the list of stuff once I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with hands and I’ve got a pickup. Send me the list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — we just need to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the time and where we’re dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring the tools, but I seem to have misplaced my list again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check the supply bin and make a fresh list for us.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That would be a lifesaver, Cleo. I’ll keep an eye out for the tools this time and try not to lose that list again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what needs repair for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s this Saturday afternoon, and we’re fixing up a few loose steps and that broken fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—what time on Saturday afternoon should I put down?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a bit late—what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all—thanks for coming. Could you help sort the donated tools and then hand them out as people arrive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I can do that. Point me to the tools and I’ll start sorting them now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs sharpening?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort through the donated tools and set aside anything that needs sharpening.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair-drive details yet, but I can keep track of where it’s happening if you tell me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the location and timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — just send me the location and timing when you have them, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support already, which is great. If you want, I can keep an eye out for any updates or volunteer needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be wonderful, Tess—thanks! Please do keep me posted, and I’ll pass the word along to anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything useful. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily, thanks for asking. I’ve mostly been hearing small updates one at a time, so I’m still piecing it together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. What’s the biggest thing you still need to figure out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive. Just tell me the details, and I’ll repeat the plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a huge help. I’m still waiting on the final details, but I’ll tell you as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll be ready to pass it along once you have the final details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can keep things moving if you want to share what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — send me the list whenever you’re ready, and I’ll help keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—folks seem ready to pitch in. If you want, I can pass along the details I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. Just let me know the time and where folks should drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—last I heard, they’re collecting donations at the community center from 9 to 2. Folks can drop everything off by the side entrance near the loading bay.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ve got the repair drive on track, and I’m still waiting on a couple folks to confirm what they’re bringing. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — thanks for the update. Let me know if you still need me to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. We still need a few hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with both sorting donations and carrying boxes. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring a flashlight and a few basic tools, and help me keep track of which houses we’ve already checked?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. I’ll bring a flashlight and some basic tools, and I’ll help keep track of the houses we’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help spread the word about the repair drive. What’s the best way for me to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — the most helpful thing is to share the repair drive details with neighbors and ask them to bring small items that need fixing. If you want, I can send you a short blurb you can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Hana — send me the blurb and I’ll share it with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I checked in with a few folks, and we’re still on for Saturday—just a couple of items need tools we don’t have yet. If you can, bring your drill and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring my drill on Saturday. Thanks for handling the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up pretty well — I’m running a few errands, but I can swing by if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Ira — could always use an extra pair of hands. Swing by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll wrap up these errands and come by soon to help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help collect a few spare tools and drop them by the community shed this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I can gather a few spare tools and drop them by the community shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to make sure we have the details lined up first—what exactly needs to be picked up and by when?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—there are a few boxes of donated tools and some paint cans to pick up by Friday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that sounds manageable—I just need the pickup address and whether we’ll need a car with a trunk or extra packing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that repair drive sounds great—I'll spread the word right away! If you want, I can invite a few folks I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be wonderful, Quinn—thank you. A few more neighbors would really help us get the supplies together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll invite a few neighbors I know and let them know to bring any tools or supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still nailing that down, but I’ll check and get you the time soon. Thanks for helping with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No problem — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. What’s the first thing you want to tackle, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — could you start by telling me who’s already signed up and what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll pull together the sign-up list and a quick rundown of the remaining repairs. Then we can see who still needs a nudge and what to prioritize first.
